caption: New quiz: give it a name
text: Making a quiz is half the fun! Press New quiz, give it a name, and off you go.
say: Making a quiz is half the fun! Press New quiz, give it a name, and off you go!

caption: Type a question, tick the right answer
text: Type a question and its answers, then tick the right one. Everything saves as you type!
say: Type a question and its answers, then tick the right one. Everything saves as you type!

caption: Eight answer types
text: Pick an answer type: true or false, typed answers, numbers, order, pins and pairs.
say: Pick an answer type: true or false, typed answers, numbers, order, pins and pairs.

caption: Pictures can zoom out or uncover tile by tile
text: Add a picture, and reveal it bit by bit while the clock runs.
say: Add a picture, and reveal it bit by bit while the clock runs!

caption: Slides introduce the rounds
text: Slides open each round, with a title and a picture.
say: Slides open each round, with a title and a picture.

caption: Add questions from the library
text: Short on ideas? Grab questions from the library, one by one or at random!
say: Short on ideas? Grab questions from the library, one by one, or at random!

caption: Find your way in a long quiz
text: The strip on the side jumps anywhere in a long quiz, and the table view shows it all at once.
say: The strip on the side jumps anywhere in a long quiz, and the table view shows it all at once.

caption: Test it before the big night
text: Then test it: the big screen and two phones, side by side. Ready for quiz night!
